copy: Duset Hotel Suites is located in the heart of Riyadh. The property is close to major shopping destinations in Riyadh: Al Nakheel Mall, Granada Market, Palm Market, Hayat Mall and the surrounding shops with eateries. Riyadh International Exhibition Center is a 5-minute drive away. The nearest airport, King Khalid Airport, is 23 km from the property. We are the providers of 71 luxury rooms with 24hrs service.
missionText: We always create unforgettable memories with our services to satisfy the needs of our customers throughout the world.
visionText: We are founded on the vision to create a unique experience for our guests by offering quality service and products, combined with warm and friendly hospitality.
coreSubline: Every stay at Duset Hotel Suites includes these essentials — standard in every room and suite.
experienceCopy: Book directly with no prepayment — pay at the hotel and enjoy the best available rate.
